artists.biography: Soulwax, headed by David and Stephen Dewaele, are an alternative rock/electronic band from Ghent, Belgium. Next to the Dewaele brothers, Soulwax consists of bassist Stefaan Van Leuven and drummer Steve Slingeneyer. They were first noticed after the release of their album Much Against Everyone's Advice. But after that the Dewaeles started focusing on their other projects such as 2manydjs (first known as The Fucking Dewaele Brothers/The Flying Dewaele Brothers). Their album "As Heard on Radio Soulwax, Pt. 2" was named the best popular music album of 2002 by The New York Times. They were also hosting a show on Belgian television, 'Alter8'. Since the release of the Soulwax album Nite Versions (a remix of the album Any Minute Now) they have been touring around the globe, almost non-stop.

Released in 2002 on Play It Again Sam, As Heard On Radio Soulwax Pt.2 by 2 Many DJ's is a landmark electronic mix album that defies easy categorization. Blending elements of rock, pop, and electronic music, the album is a genre-blurring collage that showcases the Belgian brothers Stephen and David Dewaele’s inventive approach to DJing. Seamlessly weaving together tracks from disparate artists and styles—ranging from punk and disco to hip-hop and synth-pop—the mix is celebrated for its energy, creativity, and playful juxtapositions, making it feel more like a cohesive album than a traditional DJ set.

Within 2 Many DJ's discography, As Heard On Radio Soulwax Pt.2 stands as a defining work, capturing the duo’s transition from their roots in the rock band Soulwax to their status as pioneering DJs and remixers. The album’s original radio broadcasts had already built a cult following, and its official release cemented their reputation for pushing the boundaries of what a mix album could achieve. Critically, the album was lauded for its bold eclecticism and infectious energy, earning Album of the Year and Album of the Decade accolades from major publications such as The New York Times, Spin, The Face, and Pitchfork. It also achieved significant commercial success, selling over half a million copies worldwide and influencing a generation of DJs and producers.
